rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the flag is a false alarm. The March 31, 2026 schedule explicitly reports Total Investments of $1,618,654 at 231.8% of net assets, while the balance sheet reports total net assets of $674,028; 1,562,470 / 674,028 is approximately 231.8%. The extracted percentage sum of 231.5% closely matches the filing's own schedule total, with only a 0.3 percentage-point rounding or coverage difference. A percentage of investments to net assets above 100% is therefore source-supported for this leveraged BDC, so the expected-range premise of PCT01 is inapplicable rather than the extracted data being erroneous.
